text:
Priya Shah: Heads-up, compliance team at EuroBank wants EU-only lifecycle for their POC (inference, embeddings, logs, backups). Also asked for subprocessors list (EU locations + certs), routing policy that prevents any non-EU fallback, and whether region-pinning affects pricing. Need items for SOW tonight.

Jon Keller: Quick summary: Dedicated/Private = full EU-only pin supported. Hosted = possible for enterprise tenants with contract + reserved capacity; we can enable EU tenancy and deny fallback.

Marta Lopez: Clarify: EU-only means absolutely no logs/backup replication outside EU? Some customers expect that level.

Priya Shah: Yes, they said no cross-border (non-EU) egress at all.

Evan Li: Implementation notes: set tenant.region_pin=eu, fallback_policy=deny, kv_storage and object storage in eu regions. For hosted, we map to eu-west-1 / eu-central-1. Need to pre-stage model artifacts to EU buckets to avoid external fetches during onboarding.

Evan Li: Ops config snippet:
```
region_pin: eu
allowed_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]
fallback_policy: deny
kv_storage: eu-only
log_endpoint: logstream-eu
```

Priya Shah: Subprocessors list requested. Can someone produce a short table (service, region, certs)?

Evan Li: Quick list for POC: AWS (eu-west-1, eu-central-1) - compute & S3, ISO27001/SOC2; GCP (europe-west4) - optional; LogStream (eu-west-1) - logs; Datadog EU - metrics; VaultCo (Frankfurt) - encrypted backups. I'll provide links to certs.

Jon Keller: Pricing: region pinning + reserved capacity increases costs (GPU reservation + EU storage/egress). Ballpark: Hosted-EU tenancy ~ +15% uplift; Dedicated pinned nodes ~ +25% effective per-token vs default hosted. For a 1-month POC we can offer softer uplift (~10%) as a one-off credit. Will confirm numbers after ops cost calc.

Priya Shah: Jon, please draft two bullet lines for SOW (hosted vs dedicated).

Jon Keller: Draft bullets: 1) Hosted EU tenancy (no fallback): standard hosted rates + 15% regional premium (per-token). 2) Dedicated EU-pinned tenant: reserved monthly commit (min 1 GPU node) + maintenance; approx. +25% effective unit cost but gives SLA and absolute data residency. I will add concrete figures after ops confirms capacity.

Marta Lopez: Legal needs subprocessor export + template clause. @LegalBot fetch EU-hosting subprocessor template.

LegalBot: Retrieved template: https://redwood.internal/legal/subprocessors/eu-hosting-template.md. Note: include explicit "no non-EU fallback" clause and list of subprocessors with SOC/ISO links.

Priya Shah: Ops, what's the runbook to flip this for the POC? We need steps in the SOW.

ops-bot: Runbook (high level):
1) Provision dedicated pool or allocate hosted EU tenancy
2) Create tenant finreg-poc with region_pin=eu and fallback_policy=deny
3) Copy model artifacts to EU object storage and update artifact refs
4) Point logs to LogStream EU and set retention as requested
5) Smoke test: send requests from outside EU and verify routing stays in EU and no external logs/backups occur
CLI example: redwoodctl tenant create --id finreg-poc --region-pin eu --fallback-policy deny --kv-storage eu-only

Evan Li: Caveats to call out in SOW: cross-region replication inside EU counts as intra-EU transfer (still within jurisdiction but may have separate controls), and any third-party model vendor that doesn't allow artifact hosting in EU will require vendor agreement.

Priya Shah: Action list: Jon = pricing bullets + numbers after ops confirm; Marta/Legal = subprocessor table + cert links; Ops = runbook + ETA for artifact replication; Evan = confirm vendor artifact constraints. I'll fold into SOW and send to EuroBank.

Marta Lopez: I'll export subprocessor CSV and cert URLs by tomorrow AM.

Jon Keller: I'll post draft pricing numbers by EOD.

Evan Li: Artifact replication ETA: 30-90 minutes after bucket access and producer uploads.

Priya Shah: Thanks team :thumbsup: — I'll update SOW and ping EuroBank.
